svg.text: Pin / L-slot coupling and spring stack
All dimensions mm. Collar and seat plans at 1:1; shaft section is schematic.
MOVING COLLAR
OD 32; bore 18; thickness 1.5
3 x D2.2 on R13.5, spaced 120 deg
UPPER SPRING SEAT
OD 32; bore 12.1; thickness 3
3 x D2.2 on R13.5, spaced 120 deg
SPINDLE / STACK
D4 x 16 pin: y=-6 to +10; opposite end flush
+73 spindle upper end
+59 upper bearing centre
+47 lower bearing centre
+33 upper-seat underside
+21.5 upper travel-stop face
+12.75 free collar centre
0 drive-pin centre
-10 chamfered tip
Spindle: D12 x 83; tip taper R3 at z=-10 to R6 at z=-5.
Bearings: 2 x 6801-2RS (12 x 21 x 5), centres z=+47 and +59.
3 x smooth D2 guides; lower stop washer face z=+12; 8 mm collar travel.
3 x 11.5 mm spacers below seat stop the collar upper face at +21.5.
SPRING / RETAINING POCKET
Spring: 20.2 OD, approx 18.2 ID, 32 free length; target measured rate 0.40 +/-0.05 N/mm.
At free collar: installed spring length 19.5 -> 5 +/-0.5 N preload; full travel length 11.5.
Hub: OD24, bore12.7 (+0.1/-0), z=-20..+20. Entry angular sector65..115 deg open above-3.5.
At125..175 deg the pocket ceiling is z=+8; at115..125 deg it is +3.5. Other walls as mesh.
Insert hub origin at pin z=-1, turn clockwise60 deg, release to z=-6. Do not glue the coupling.
Native CAD and exported hub preserve this section. Ream/finish the bore and inspect the slot.
Orbit shaft: D12 x70, installed z=382..452 (mixer frame); no axle below the spring stack.
Its upper-plate cross-pin is at z390. All spindle dimensions above are relative to its own pin.
Commission spring force, clearances, retention and interlocks on the actual build before trials.
